_comment: HubSpot-flavoured config used to exercise fixtures/raw-hubspot offline: python3 scripts/analyze.py --raw fixtures/raw-hubspot --out /tmp/h --config fixtures/config.hubspot.json. The only difference from config.example.json is that field names are HubSpot internal property names, which are lower_snake_case and do not match Salesforce API names. Copy this shape when setting up a HubSpot portal.
